literal_meaning: চরণ (পাদ) দাস (সেবক) – একটি নাম যা 'পাদসেবক' বা নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তির নাম
figurative_meaning_en: The Vaishnava community that follows Charan Das
example_sentences_in_bangla: চরণদাস সম্প্রদায়ের লোকেরা ভক্তিমার্গে অগ্রসর হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: They are known as followers of Charan Das.
Members of the Charan Das community advance on the path of devotion.
history: Charan Das was a 16th-17th century Vaishnava saint and poet in Bengal, a follower of Chaitanya Mahaprabhu, who established a distinct sect emphasizing devotion and ethical living.
note: This term refers to a specific religious sect rather than a common figurative idiom.
